reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's favourite V3 model — per-platform pred = lag(k*(pred0 - b), tau, dt=0.02) with per-segment lag reset — using {b,k,tau} loaded from out/<PLATFORM>__ladder.json for each Ford platform.
notes: Per-platform coefficients: Mach-E (b=2.271627e-04, k=1.068590, tau=0.08), F-150 (b=3.627745e-03, k=0.859774, tau=0.06). Baseline-recomputed matches canonical to 0.00e+00. Agent trained on the same Ford segments (interleaved-5 split, train=1/5); leakage accepted per canonical spec.
